def load():

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

G=load(); print(sorted(G))

from collections import deque
def comps(g, vals):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j] in vals and not seen[i][j]:
                q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True; cells=[]
                while q:
                    r,c=q.popleft(); cells.append((r,c))
                    for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                        if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and not seen[nr][nc] and g[nr][nc] in vals:
                            seen[nr][nc]=True; q.append((nr,nc))
                out.append(cells)
    return out

def norm(cells):
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    r0,c0=min(rs),min(cs)
    h=max(rs)-r0+1; w=max(cs)-c0+1
    m=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r,c in cells: m[r-r0][c-c0]=1
    return m

def rot(m): return [list(r) for r in zip(*m[::-1])]
def shape_key(m):
    ks=[m]
    for _ in range(3): ks.append(rot(ks[-1]))
    return min(tuple(tuple(r) for r in k) for k in ks)

def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]
    blocks=comps(g,{8})
    legend=comps(g,set(range(1,10))-{8})
    tot_b=sum(len(c) for c in blocks); tot_l=sum(len(c) for c in legend)
    s=int(round((tot_b/tot_l)**0.5))
    lshapes=[(shape_key(norm(c)), c[0][0], c[0][1], g[c[0][0]][c[0][1]]) for c in legend]
    bshapes=[(shape_key(norm([[1]*(len(c)//1) for c in []] ) if False else norm(c)), ) for c in blocks]
    # block normalized shape: dims//s
    binfo=[]
    for c in blocks:
        rs=[r for r,_ in c]; cs=[_,__ for _,__ in []]
        cs=[c2 for _,c2 in c]
        h=(max(rs)-min(rs)+1)//s; w=(max(cs)-min(cs)+1)//s
        key=shape_key([[1]*w for _ in range(h)])
